notes.title: Fuck You Witch. Horror Universe.
notes.notes:
Salaam alaikum warriors and horsemen!

Here, in the fiery steppes, where beshbarmak is worth its weight in gold, where horses snort under the full moon and spring weddings are as wild as a March hare, our game, Fuck You Witch, was born!

The game was created for those who want to feel like a hero, but are afraid to get off the couch. A game in which beshbarmak protects against obesity, and swearing saves your soul from heaven... and from the witch.

This isn’t just a simulator—it’s the ultimate anti-stress experience, where your main weapons are Russian swearing, the untamed spirit of the Kazakh steppes, and the freedom to unleash it all!

But there is a problem that we want to share with you zhek pi zhek.

* Zhek pi zhek is a Mambet catchphrase that refers to a brutal one-on-one fistfight behind the garages. **

**A one-on-one brutal fistfight behind the garages implies that you’ll be jumped by several people in a deserted spot, left beaten, and stripped of everything you have.

The minute of educational facts is over, let's return to pressing problems. 

We have encountered financial difficulties that may prevent us from continuing to create unique games for you.

This year we have released six games based on the Fuck You Witch universe. These are: 
- Fuck You Witch
- 10:59 
- SNAP SNAP
- Twelve Sticks
-QR Dead 
- the demo of VIDEoPHOBIA 
- Writer. Chapter 1.

A total of seven games — it’s really fucking awesome, right?

We won’t go into detail here about the “Fuck You Witch” universe. If you want, we’ll make a separate video about it. It will be even more pleasant to see your comments, theories, and videos on this.

For now, let’s just say we plan to keep expanding this universe with more games, including a direct sequel to Fuck You Witch—and maybe even more than one! We have several ideas, we guarantee you will go fucking nuts!

But no matter how much we dream about it, now we are faced with difficulties that threaten our dream.

[b]Therefore, we ask you: SUPPORT US![/b]

We have prepared a set with our games, by purchasing which you help save our studio.

Leave a review—your opinion helps us become better. Remember, the kind words of our brothers and sisters are more nourishing to the soul than any kumiss, and they truly inspire us!

Tell your friends, moms, dads, grandparents, and your president about our game. Who knows, maybe it’ll inspire something truly useful in their next speech to the nation!

Write Elon Musk after all!

We believe that with your support, we can keep creating games that relieve stress, bring a smile to your face, and give your parents extra reasons to kick you out—or your neighbors a reason to call the police or the mental hospital orderlies!

Only together with you will we raise the obscenity screams above the mountains!

[b]Thank you for being with us! ❤[/b]

Link to bundle: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41351/FUCK_YOU_WITCH_Xorror_Vselennaya/

notes.title: F💔💔k You Witch - They were alive. (OST. NOT by Mick Gordon).
notes.notes:
Salaam alaikum batyrs!

Almost a month has passed since the release, today we want to share news with you.

First, we would like to thank everyone for their support.
- Many thanks to everyone who buys the game. This is the greatest support you can give us. Rakhmet to you very much from the bottom of my heart.
- We thank all the bloggers/streamers who played our game, and, from the bottom of our hearts, threw a like on our trailer and encouraged their audience to like it.
- We thank the viewers for their adequate reaction to the streamers who wanted to return the game as a joke (or really wanted). You guys are awesome!
- Just a huge rakhmet to all of you for such laudatory reviews and such pleasant comments, the vast majority of all reactions are really like that. We’ll show off in front of our buddies in the yard about how smart guys we are not only according to our moms but to the Internet in general!

As for the future fate of the studio: for now we are putting work on pause.

Despite all the popularity and positive reviews, the game has low sales 30% returns. WTF?

We will definitely return to development if the situation changes.

Some blabber about the situation: if you like the product of some studio, support the developers by purchasing the game. This is your investment and your contribution to the development of game development. Otherwise, then there will be a lot of crying and crying about how there are only donation dumps all around and boring projects with drawn-out gameplay. The developers will whine and whine a lot that they can’t continue development.
- Oogwey Suleimenov. 318 674 BC, 2 pm 00 minutes 01 seconds

We leave gracefully, post a music video with a track that everyone got so excited about during the playthrough.

Fill your cups with kumis and drink to us.

Everybody dance!

notes.title: Update #1.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884862/5f524de048bc76b635fd30a1c3703cd2395f549f.png[/img]

1. Improved the ability to complete the game for players with processors that do not support the necessary instructions for AI in button mode.
2. The maximum number of saves from which overwriting of previous ones begins has been increased to 30.
3. The display of save time in Russian has been changed.
4. Fixed a situation where the save could be damaged after interacting with a box of potatoes.
5. FIxes in the download system.
6. Bugs in some autosaves have been fixed.
7. Added a tooltip for the lantern.
8. Fixed some items in the village that were hanging in the air.
9. Removed the dot in the center of the screen in some titles.
10. Changed a number of sounds to improve the gaming experience.
11. Removed the ability to interact with a number of items before this is possible in terms of gameplay.
12. Bugs with camera visual effects have been fixed.
13. Fixed the ability to pick up more key items than needed.
14. Improved lighting and shadow rendering.
15. Improved texture streaming algorithm.
16. Fixed bugs with the display of some textures.
17. Fixed and improved several jump scares.
18. Added voice overs for the MPC at some points in the game.
19. Improved visibility of the icon above the 'miracle grass.'
20. Fixed a bug when the player saw a notification about adding non-existent tasks.
21. Improved map performance.
22. Fixed some bugs that made it impossible to progress through the game without loading the last save.
23. Improved interaction for some items in the scene.
24. Some other minor bug fixes.
